transport.title: Getting there
transport.text: Minibus taxi No. 15 and bus No. 7 run to the Aeroport stop. Timetable on bus13.ru.

storage.title: Left luggage
storage.text: Left luggage for domestic and international passengers in the domestic terminal, open round the clock. Locker 50×40×50 — 100 ₽ per hour, 70×60×70 — 150 ₽, 100×70×100 — 200 ₽.

kids.title: With children
kids.text: The mother and child room is free, for children under 7 with one adult. Ask the staff at the check-in counters; children are examined by the duty medical officer before admission.

parking.title: Parking
parking.text: Station forecourt 30 m from the terminal: less than 15 minutes free, more than 15 minutes 200 ₽ per hour, more than an hour 600 ₽ per day.

wifi.title: Wi‑Fi
wifi.text: Free Wi‑Fi from the airport: network Free WiFi, login with a phone number and an SMS code; numbers of foreign operators also work.
